errors.evidence: The chart does not contain any error bars. It shows two line series representing two different conditions.
The Y-axis does not have a label. The machine description has hallucinated the label "聚集系数" (clustering coefficient).
The Y-axis major tick marks are at 0.075, 0.125, 0.175, 0.225. The interval between them is 0.05, not 0.025.
The starting point for the red line at A1 has a value of 0.200, not 0.175. The value 0.175 corresponds to the point at B1 for the red line.

errors.text_span: 这些数值变动范围从0.113到0.175
errors.evidence: The range of all data points shown in the chart is from 0.113 (blue line at C2) to 0.200 (red line at A1), not 0.113 to 0.175.
The legend label for the red line is '去除偏误' (Error removed), not the garbled text provided in the description.
The legend label for the blue line is '未去除偏误' (Error not removed). The description is missing the last character '误'.
